verses.gurmukhi: ੧੯ : ਪੰਜਵੀਂ ਪਾਤਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ
verses.translit_en: 19 : pa(n)javee(n) paatashaahee dhe hor si'khaa(n) dhe naam

en.bdb: Other sikhs of the fifth Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗੂ ਨਾਊ ਸਹਗਲਾ ਰਾਮਾ ਧਰਮਾ ਉਦਾ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)goo naauoo sahagalaa raamaa dharamaa udhaa bhaiee|

en.bdb: Gangu is a barber and Rama, Dharma, Uda are Sahgal brothers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਟੂ ਭਟੂ ਵੇਤਿਆ ਫਿਰਣਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਵਡਾ ਸਤ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jaToo bhaToo vetiaa firanaa soodh vaddaa sat bhaiee|

en.bdb: Bhai Jattu, Bhattu, Banta, and Phirana are Sud brothers and love each other very much.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੋਲੂ ਭਟੂ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਤੇਵਾੜੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bholoo bhaToo jaaneean sanamukh tevaaRee sukhadhaiee|

en.bdb: Bholu, Bhattu and Tivari give happiness to others and are known as the Sikhs of the court of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡਲਾ ਭਾਗੀ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਾਪੂ ਨਿਵਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: ddalaa bhaagee bhagat hai jaapoo nivalaa gur saranaiee|

en.bdb: Dalla , Bhagi , Japu and Nivala have come to the shelter of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਾ ਸੂਜਾ ਧਾਵਣੇ ਚੰਦੂ ਚਉਝੜ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: moolaa soojaa dhaavane cha(n)dhoo chaujhaR sev kamaiee|

en.bdb: Mula, Suja of Dhavan caste and Chandu of Chaujhar caste have served (in the guru-court).
Mula, Suja of Dhavan caste and Chandu of Chaujhar caste have served (in the guru-court).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਬੀਬੜਾ ਮਾਛੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh bisan beebaRaa maachhee su(n)dhar gurmat paiee|

en.bdb: The fishermen Bisanu, Bibara and Sundar presenting themselves to the Guru have adopted the teachings of the Guru.
Great is the grandeur of the holy congregation.
